modelDescription: Attractive, Accurate and Affordable. These classically-styled rifles offer premium features at a great value: LBA adjustable triggers, fluted and threaded barrels, oversized bolt handles, spiral fluted bolts, top-mount Picatinny rail/scope bases and 4-round box magazines.
